description: Calculate the Ashtottari Dasha (108-year cycle). An alternative to Vimshottari (120-year) used when Rahu is in a Kendra or Trikona from the Lagna lord, or when the birth is at night in Krishna Paksha / day in Shukla Paksha. Uses 8 planets (excludes Ketu) with periods: Sun 6y, Moon 15y, Mars 8y, Mercury 17y, Saturn 10y, Jupiter 19y, Rahu 12y, Venus 21y = 108 total. Returns current Mahadasha, Antardasha, and full timeline with start/end dates. Cost: $0.020/call.

ayanamsa.description: Sidereal zodiac correction. Default: lahiri. Only for Vedic calculations.

datetime.description: Birth date and time in ISO 8601 format, e.g. "1990-06-15T14:30:00". Required for all chart calculations.

depth.description: Level of detail. mahadasha=main periods only. antardasha=include sub-periods (default). pratyantardasha=include sub-sub-periods.

latitude.description: Birth location latitude (-90 to 90). Polar latitudes >66.5 are rejected (house calculations unreliable).

timezone.description: Timezone as UTC offset "+05:30" or IANA "Asia/Kolkata". UTC offsets preferred.

name: vedika_dasha_ashtottari
